text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ryan, thanks for giving me that present.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I was shocked though... You must know
your stuff
to find a body mist that fancy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, well, I wanted to get something
special for
the occasion. I had to go to a
nice boutique.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of, want to go there with me
next time?
They have all kinds of
interesting things.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I know it's pretty hard to figure
out that
stuff, but maybe we could help
each other learn...
right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
And, hey, if you're there with me, I
wouldn't feel
so awkward!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you're right. I'd feel better having
you with
me too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Awesome, let's do it! This weekend,
we're going
shopping!
